descriptionChirho: A gentilic noun/adjective denoting a person or people from Midian, used in Numbers 25 and Judges to identify individuals or groups of Midianite origin. The two clusters differ only in grammatical number — singular 'the Midianite' including feminine 'the Midianite woman' (eng: the Midianite / the Midianite woman, spa: el madianita / la madianita, hin: मिद्यानी, arb: الْمِدْيَانِيِّ / الْمِدْيَانِيَّةِ, kor: 그 미디안인) versus plural 'the Midianites' (eng: the Midianites, spa: los madianitas, arb: مِدْيانِيُّونَ, kor: 미디안 사람들, swa: Wamidiani).
